records.summary: Marathon Oil, a Pertamina contractor, made an exploratory oil find in deep water in the South China Sea northwest of Natuna Island, in the area claimed by both Indonesia and Vietnam, reported by the US embassy in July 1978; Indonesian officials said in September that current oil exploration including the Marathon strike would fall on Vietnam's side under Vietnam's proposal and that Indonesia was unlikely even to listen to a Vietnamese request to halt exploration.
records.presort: continuation of ev-0245dbdd94 (a candidate, provisional) — The 1977 record (ev-0245dbdd94) shows Indonesian oil exploration already under way in the disputed shelf and defended against a moratorium; Marathon's 1978 find continues that exploration at the same level. Doubt: it is in a different contract area (northwest of Natuna), so a coder who reads it as new acreage could call it scope. [claude-code/opus]
